answer: To resist Sybil attacks, an agent economy funnels registration through a validated inlet where minting identities requires irreversible cryptographic stake burning. Operating each verified beacon demands staking resources scaled by a superlinear cost curve O(n^2), where n is the cluster size. Malicious attempts to dissolve or hollow out consensus collapse against this exponential friction, making network subversion as economically ruinous as traversing porous karst.
